Definition: adverb from G2470; likely, i.e. perhaps:--it may be.
BiblicalUsage: Perhaps is the word of a father's hope in the parable of the vineyard. In Luke 20:13 the lord of the vineyard says, I will send my beloved son, it may be they will reverence him when they see him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the perhaps is the tragedy of the parable: the father hoped, and the husbandmen killed the son anyway.
RelatedEvents: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants
